_comment: Workbench upgrades. Each weapon has three tiers bought in order with salvage. 'damage' and 'stamina' multiply the weapon's base numbers at that tier (cumulative values, not per-step). 'special' is applied at tier 3: finisher_bonus adds to the combo finisher multiplier, armor_bonus adds to the armour multiplier, charge_bonus adds to charged heavy damage.

tiers.label: Balanced: +25% damage, combo finisher hits harder
Harmonic: +25% damage, charged strikes hit harder
